==Behind the scenes==
The laser pinwheel appeared in ''[[The Game Chambers of Questal]]'', a [[Roleplaying game|roleplaying]] adventure written by [[Robert Kern]] and published by [[West End Games]] for use with ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="Questal" />
